name: realtime-tex
description: Live LaTeX preview that re-typesets the paragraph you are editing in about a millisecond, powered by realtime-tex (rtex).

commands.title: Open Live Preview to the Side

realtimeTex.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `rtex` binary. Leave empty to use the copy installed by **Realtime TeX: Install rtex**, or `rtex` from your `PATH`.

realtimeTex.texliveBin.markdownDescription: Folder that contains `lualatex` (TeX Live 2026 or newer). Leave empty to use your `PATH`. Examples: `/usr/local/texlive/2026/bin/x86_64-linux`, `C:\texlive\2026\bin\windows`.

realtimeTex.texDir.markdownDescription: rtex's `tex/` support files (sets `RTEX_TEXDIR`). Only needed if you moved the rtex binary away from them: a release keeps them in `share/rtex/tex` next to `bin/`, a source build in the checkout's `tex/`.

enumDescriptions: Download the prebuilt rtex of the latest realtime-tex release (a few MB, no Rust needed)
Clone realtime-tex main and build rtex with cargo (needs Rust; has changes before they are released)
realtimeTex.installFrom.markdownDescription:
What **Install rtex** does. Updates follow the way the rtex in use was installed. Building from source is also available any time as **Realtime TeX: Install rtex (Build from Source)**.

[Install rtex now](command:realtimeTex.installRtex)

enumDescriptions: Once a day, install the latest build of the extension's main branch (every merged change)
Once a day, install the latest tagged release
Never update by itself; use Realtime TeX: Check for Extension Updates
realtimeTex.extensionUpdates.markdownDescription: Keep this extension up to date by itself. It is not on the Marketplace: a newer `.vsix` is downloaded from the GitHub repository of `#realtimeTex.extensionRepository#` (the extension's own repository by default), checked against its published SHA-256 and installed; **Reload Window** then runs it.

realtimeTex.extensionRepository.markdownDescription: GitHub repository the extension updates itself from (`owner/name` or its URL). Empty: the repository the extension was built from.

enumDescriptions: Once a day, say when a newer rtex is available and offer to update
Once a day, update rtex by itself when a newer one is available
Never check; update with the command only
realtimeTex.updateCheck.markdownDescription:
Keep the rtex engine installed by the extension up to date. A downloaded rtex updates to the latest release of `realtimeTex.engine.repository` when it is a GitHub repository ([kenny-21342/realtime-tex releases](https://github.com/kenny-21342/realtime-tex/releases) by default); one built from source pulls `realtimeTex.engine.repository` and `.branch` (the fork's `kenny/main` by default) and rebuilds it (needs `git` and `cargo`). The engine restarts on the new rtex.

[Update rtex now](command:realtimeTex.updateRtex)

realtimeTex.engine.repository.markdownDescription: Git repository the managed rtex engine comes from: built from source by **Install rtex (Build from Source)**, and, when it is on GitHub, the repository whose releases **Install rtex** downloads (**Update rtex Engine** and the daily check follow it). Leave empty for [kenny-21342/realtime-tex](https://github.com/kenny-21342/realtime-tex), the fork with this extension's engine work. Example: `https://github.com/HenryXiaoYang/realtime-tex` (upstream).

realtimeTex.engine.branch.markdownDescription: Branch of `realtimeTex.engine.repository` to build. Leave empty for the fork's `kenny/main` (its `main` mirrors upstream), or `main` for any other repository.

enumDescriptions: Typeset a part live when its live result matched the last full compile, whatever commands it uses (rtex's default)
Typeset live only parts made of commands rtex knows to be safe
realtimeTex.engine.eligibility.markdownDescription: How rtex decides which parts of the document can update live. See realtime-tex's [live editing guide](https://github.com/kenny-21342/realtime-tex/blob/kenny/main/docs/live-editing.md). Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.fastBudgetMs.markdownDescription: Time budget, in milliseconds, for re-typesetting one part live. A part that takes longer three times in a row waits for the full compile until the next layout. Raise it on a slow computer. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.fastBudgetFactor.markdownDescription: The budget follows the document: a part is only too slow when it also takes longer than this many times the document's typical live update. With fonts that make every paragraph slow (HarfBuzz, long paragraphs), they stay live past the fixed budget. `0` uses `#realtimeTex.engine.fastBudgetMs#` alone. Needs rtex with `--fast-budget-factor`. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.passTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: A full compile still running after this many seconds is stopped, for example a document that loops forever. Raise it for very long documents. Needs rtex with `--pass-timeout-ms`. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.pictureCache.markdownDescription: Reuse unchanged TikZ pictures from the previous full compile, which makes full compiles of drawing-heavy documents several times faster. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.holdBrokenPictures.markdownDescription: While an edit leaves a TikZ picture (or a part typeset live) with errors, for example a half-typed coordinate, keep showing its last good version, outlined, until the errors are fixed. Turn off to see the broken output at once. Needs rtex 0.0.6 or later. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.mainFile.markdownDescription: Main `.tex` file of the project, relative to the workspace folder. Leave empty to detect it automatically (from a `% !TEX root = …` comment or the file containing `\documentclass`).

realtimeTex.buildDir.markdownDescription: Where rtex keeps its build files. Leave empty to keep them out of your project (in VS Code's workspace storage).

realtimeTex.exportPath.markdownDescription: Where **Export PDF** writes the PDF. `${mainDir}` is the folder of the main file, `${mainName}` its name without extension.

realtimeTex.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start the engine as soon as a LaTeX file is opened, without waiting for the preview to be opened.

realtimeTex.syncCursor.markdownDescription: Scroll the preview to follow the text cursor.

realtimeTex.editor.liveMarkers.markdownDescription: Mark each part of the source next to the line numbers while the preview runs: a **solid green bar** means the part updates live as you type, a **dotted amber bar** means it waits for the full compile (the preamble, TikZ, …). Hover over a marked part that went to the full compile to see why.

realtimeTex.preview.invertInDarkTheme.markdownDescription: Show pages with dark background and light text when VS Code uses a dark theme.

enumDescriptions: Fit the page width to the preview panel

realtimeTex.stopWhenPreviewCloses.markdownDescription: Stop the engine when the preview is closed (frees memory). Turn off to keep diagnostics updating without a preview.

realtimeTex.debug.enabled.markdownDescription:
Have rtex save a debug bundle whenever the live engine hangs, crashes or loses its state: the source it was typesetting, the replayed context, a per-stage trace with font loads, and the TeX log (with `\tracingmacros`). Every live compile is also listed in `requests.log`. Changing it restarts the engine. Needs realtime-tex `be0e074` or newer.

[Open debug folder](command:realtimeTex.openDebugFolder)

realtimeTex.debug.directory.markdownDescription: Where debug bundles go. Leave empty to use the extension's storage folder (open it with **Realtime TeX: Open Debug Folder**).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Realtime TeX
walkthroughs.description: See your LaTeX document update as you type, in about a millisecond per keystroke.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
Realtime TeX needs **LuaLaTeX** (TeX Live 2026+) and the **rtex** engine. Linux, macOS and Windows are supported.
[Check Setup](command:realtimeTex.checkSetup)

steps.title: Install the rtex engine
steps.description:
If the check says rtex is missing, install it with one click: the prebuilt engine of the latest realtime-tex release is downloaded (a few MB).
[Install rtex](command:realtimeTex.installRtex)
Prefer to build it yourself? [Build from source](command:realtimeTex.buildFromSource) (needs Rust). Already have it? [Locate the rtex binary](command:realtimeTex.selectServerPath)

steps.title: Open the live preview
steps.description:
Open a `.tex` file and click the preview icon in the editor's top-right corner, or press **Ctrl+Alt+V** (**Cmd+Alt+V** on Mac).
[Open Live Preview](command:realtimeTex.openPreview)

steps.title: Jump between source and preview
steps.description: **Double-click** in the preview to jump to that paragraph in the source. The preview follows your cursor automatically; press **Ctrl+Alt+J** to jump there on demand.

steps.title: Export a PDF
steps.description:
When you are done, export a PDF that matches a clean LuaLaTeX build.
[Export PDF](command:realtimeTex.exportPdf)
